whyItMatters: Composer resolves these names against the configured repositories, so a name that only looks like the intended package installs foreign code. The name this rule expects is `friendsofphp/php-cs-fixer`.
actions: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `friendsofphp/php-cs-fixer`, correct it to that exact spelling.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm composer.json no longer carries a declared package name in composer.json within one edit of `friendsofphp/php-cs-fixer`.
